headline: The workload coming in three acts
summary: Mexican businesses face key decisions in coming weeks on the minimum wage and implementation of a 40-hour working week. They also face labour pressures in the review of the USMCA trade agreement.
why: Minimum wage and working-time rules directly change labour costs for Mexican companies. The USMCA review affects trade and investment between Mexico, the US and Canada.
original_headline: La intensidad laboral que se avecina en tres actos
